_doc: Der Kranich's living world (UPDATE 10 §3, contract C1, DECISIONS T-156): the kinds in the `# ---- U10 Act II ----` block at the end of gravelight/world/landscape/map_ambience.gd; MapRoot attaches the MapAmbience because this file exists; needs_landscape false: no Landscape in flight. Presentation only, every peer its own. The outside itself (the legs below: the coast, then the ocean, then America; the clouds; the fighter passes; London's flak and searchlights) is FlightSky's (map04b.json flight.sky) and stays there; the London window keeps its own timing (london_window.gd). flight_sun: night to dawn from from_act_round to to_act_round (round_s per round for the in-between), the sky's aft glow (FlightSky.set_sunrise, up to dawn_max) and the Moon light warming to dawn_color at dawn_energy_mult. formation: bombers holding station at `offsets` (map frame, m) bobbing bob_m; `down`: once per act from from_act_round, at_s into the round, the bomber `victim` is hit by flak and falls fall_s trailing fire (squad line M4B_FORMATION_DOWN). flak_field: far flak every interval s, radius m out, from from_act_round. st_elmo: violet-blue glows at `points` (the wingtips, the flight deck's frame) from from_act_round, brighter in a tilt. kranich_frost: the skin shader's frost per act round (by_act_round, the climb to altitude and down again over America), eased at rate_per_s. rivets: per_bank [min, max] rivets pop within radius m of the listener over spread_s of each tilt. engine_pitch: the engine bed sags `sag` and wobbles `wobble` with the Triebwerk's strain (per_blast for an explosion in `zone`, the Bordwart's lost health while he stands there; decays decay_per_s). london_hush: the `bus` ducks duck_db over fade_s while the London window runs. cables: cable bundles [x, y, z, length] hung in the group FlightSky swings.
